units.source_text: 这里的主人纪伊守家里，有好几个可爱的童子。

en.t: In the household of Kii no Kami, the master of this place, there were several charming young pages.

units.source_text: 其中有几个是在殿上当侍童的，源氏公子觉得面熟；

en.t: Among them were a few who served as pages at court, and Prince Genji found their faces familiar;

units.source_text: 有几个是伊豫介的儿子。

en.t: others were sons of the Iyo no Suke.

units.source_text: 在这许多童子中，有一个仪态特别优雅、年方十二三的男孩。

en.t: Among all these boys, there was one twelve or thirteen years old whose bearing was especially graceful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子问道：“这是谁家的孩子？”

en.t: Prince Genji asked, "Whose child is this?"

units.source_text: 纪伊守答道：“这是已故卫门督的幼子，名叫小君。

en.t: Kii no Kami replied, "He is the youngest son of the late Emon no Kami, and his name is Kogimi.

units.source_text: 他父亲在日很疼爱他。

en.t: His father was very fond of him while he was alive.

units.source_text: 小时候死了父亲，就跟随他姐姐到这里来了。

en.t: He lost his father when he was small, and came here with his elder sister.

units.source_text: 人还算聪明，是个老老实实的孩子。

en.t: He is fairly clever and an honest, well-behaved child.

units.source_text: 希望当个殿上侍童，只因无人提拔，还未成功呢。”

en.t: He hopes to become a page at court, but since no one has promoted him, it has not yet come about."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“很可怜的。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "How pitiful.

units.source_text: 那么他的姐姐就是你的后母吧？”

en.t: Then his sister must be your stepmother, must she not?"

units.source_text: 纪伊守说：“正是。”

en.t: Kii no Kami said, "That is so."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“你有这个后母，很不相称呢。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "It seems quite unsuitable that you should have such a stepmother.

units.source_text: 皇上也知道这个女子，他曾经问起：‘卫门督有过密奏，想把这女儿送入宫中服务。

en.t: The Emperor also knew of this woman, and once asked, 'Emon no Kami once made a private petition, hoping to send this daughter into palace service.

units.source_text: 现在这个人怎么样了？’

en.t: What has become of her now?'

units.source_text: 想不到她终于嫁给了你父亲。

en.t: Who would have thought that she would end up marrying your father?

units.source_text: 人世因缘真是渺茫无定啊！”

en.t: The bonds of this world are truly vague and uncertain!"

units.source_text: 他说时装出老成的样子。

en.t: As he said this, he put on an air of maturity.

units.source_text: 纪伊守接口道：“她嫁过来，是事出意外的。

en.t: Kii no Kami answered, "Her marriage into this household was quite unexpected.

units.source_text: 男女因缘，从古以来难以捉摸。

en.t: The ties between men and women have been hard to fathom since ancient times.

units.source_text: 女人的命运，尤为渺茫难知，真可怜啊！”

en.t: A woman's fate is especially uncertain and unknowable; it is truly pitiful!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“听说伊豫介很重视她，把她看作主人一般，真的么？”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I hear that the Iyo no Suke values her highly and treats her almost like the mistress of the house. Is that true?"

units.source_text: 纪伊守说：“不消说了。

en.t: Kii no Kami said, "There is no need even to say it.

units.source_text: 简直把她当作秘藏的主人呢。

en.t: He treats her almost like a treasured mistress kept under lock and key.

units.source_text: 我们全家人都看不惯，这老人太好色了。”

en.t: Everyone in our household finds it hard to watch; the old man is far too amorous."

units.source_text: 源氏公子又说：“所以他不肯把这女子让给像你那样年貌相称的时髦小伙子呀。

en.t: Prince Genji went on, "So that is why he refuses to yield the woman to a stylish young man like you, whose age and appearance would suit her so well.

units.source_text: 你父亲年纪虽老，是个风流潇洒的男子呢。”

en.t: Though your father is old, he is quite a refined and gallant gentleman."

units.source_text: 谈了一会，他又问：“这女子现在在什么地方？”

en.t: After they had talked for a while, he asked again, "Where is this woman now?"

units.source_text: 纪伊守答道：“我教她们都迁居到后面的小屋里去。

en.t: Kii no Kami replied, "I told them all to move to the small rooms at the back.

units.source_text: 但是时间局促，她还来不及迁走呢。”

en.t: But there was so little time that she has not yet managed to move away."

units.source_text: 这时候随从者酒力发作，都在廊上睡得肃静无声了。

en.t: By then the attendants had been overcome by the wine, and all lay sleeping silently on the veranda.
